notes: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2025 (matches data.js fy 'Mar 2025'). Toyota reports under IFRS in Japanese yen, so all values are billions of JPY (converted exactly from yen in millions, no FX). Source is the Form 20-F filed with the SEC on June 18, 2025 (accession 0001193125-25-142326, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094517/000119312525142326/d925022d20f.htm); the text was read from Toyota's own PDF copy of that 20-F on global.toyota because www.sec.gov refused the research user agent. The dividend figure is cross-checked against SEC XBRL. LEADER STAKE: the 20-F gives Akio Toyoda's holding as 23,747 thousand shares (as of June 2025) but states no percentage, so pctEconomic is null. For reference only, 23,747,000 / 13,048,929,774 shares outstanding at March 31, 2025 (Item 7.A) is about 0.18%; this is derived, not disclosed. No Toyoda family aggregate holding is disclosed. The 20-F names Sakichi Toyoda and Kiichiro Toyoda as founders but does not describe Akio Toyoda's family relationship to them, so relation is set to 'chair' to match his disclosed role; 'founding-family' could fit but is not sourced here. HOLDERS: the 5% table is 'as of the most recent practicable date', with no date given, and is measured as a 'Percentage of Outstanding Voting Shares'. It does not reconcile with the March 31, 2025 outstanding count: 1,192,331 thousand / 13,048,929,774 = 9.14%, against the stated 9.16%. So its denominator is a different date or a voting-rights basis (in Japan, shares below one trading unit carry no vote). ownership.asOf is therefore null; the leader's share count is as of June 2025. Japanese trust banks (custodians) are not listed because they are not 5% beneficial owners. BUYBACKS: the cash-flow line is labelled 'Reissuance (repurchase) of treasury stock', a net line; the statement of changes in equity shows gross 'Repurchase of treasury stock (1,179,043)' and a non-cash 'Reissuance of treasury stock 2,222' for FY2025. No XBRL fact for the buyback is in the SEC companyfacts API, so the xbrl object is omitted. Dividends exclude ¥127,232 million paid to non-controlling interests. STOCK COMP: null. The 20-F does not state a company-wide share-based compensation expense. The only XBRL share-based figure (ifrs-full:KeyManagementPersonnelCompensationSharebasedPayment, ¥1.94 billion) covers directors only, and the employee ESOP Trust share plan was only approved on March 24, 2025, so it adds nothing to FY2025.
